summary: Updated every doc surface the slice's behavior touches: the `iac_agent` role README (installs from `support/iac-agent/`, no sibling checkout — the contradiction with defaults/main.yml is gone), `docs/runbooks/iac-agent.md` (image row is now `registry:5000/iac` built by this repo's `iac-image` job with the venv baked at build time; the IaCAgent-repo row folded into the this-repo row; job inventory corrected to six `iac-controller` jobs plus the pod-agent `iac-image`/`architecture`; DR no longer says clone IaCAgent; new 'the `iac` image rebuild' section covering the six watched inputs, the skipped-for-conditional path, the changeset-scoped retry hole and the two ways to force a rebuild), `docs/runbooks/operator-workstation.md` (the `pvginkel/homelab` section described a filesystem-mirror bake that no image has — corrected to the `tfmirror.home` network mirror, verified in both `support/iac-image/terraform.rc` and `/work/DockerImages/modern-app-dev/terraform.rc`), the repo README layout, `CLAUDE.md`'s related-repos line (IaCAgent marked superseded, `support/iac-agent/` named as the copy to edit; the clone stays per N5), and `tools/ai_workflow/send_message.py`'s provenance comment. `AnsibleSpecs/decisions.md:117` now places `iac-impl` in `pvginkel/Ansible` at `support/iac-agent/bin/iac-impl` — edited in place, no second entry; the move needed no new doctrine (it lands under the existing `support/` convention, and no standing rule in decisions.md placed the host glue in its own repo). Behavioral claims grounded in source, not the plan: the gate logic in `Jenkinsfile.iac-image`, `utils.hasChanges`'s `currentBuild.changeSets` + `==~` full-match read from `pvginkel/JenkinsPipelineUtils.git vars/utils.groovy:33-41` via gitblit, `iac-impl`'s default repo set and baked-venv warning, `support/iac-image/Dockerfile`'s COPY set, and `install.sh`'s materialized targets. Untouched by charter: `docs/architecture/ansible-architecture.yaml` (nudge below), `.kubecoder/config.yaml` + `Ansible.code-workspace` (N5/N7), the AnsibleSpecs historical records naming IaCAgent, and `AnsibleSpecs/README.md`'s slice line (close_slice.py's). V13 is satisfied: decisions.md updated, architecture nudge raised. Gates run on branch phase/013-docs: `kc project lint`, `kc project test`, `kc project build` — all green (ansible yamllint + ansible-lint, terraform fmt, arch-validate). Committed as 014d7ac (Ansible) and f5d496e (AnsibleSpecs, decisions.md staged by name). ARCHITECTURE NUDGE — worth running the `update-architecture` agent: the slice removed a repo boundary. `docs/architecture/ansible-architecture.yaml:338` still gives the `ss:iac` (iac shim) element `sourceRepository: git:pvginkel/IaCAgent`; that tree is now `support/iac-agent/` inside `git:pvginkel/Ansible`, so an external source repository disappeared from the model. Nothing else in the model moved — no new host, daemon or service. OPERATOR-OWED, unchanged by this phase (R6 ruling): the parity apply `cd /work/Ansible/ansible && cexec iac poetry run ansible-playbook playbooks/site.yml --limit iac_agent --check` (delete `--check` to apply), then removing IaCAgent from `.kubecoder/config.yaml` + `Ansible.code-workspace` and archiving `pvginkel/IaCAgent`. No runbook was created for it — it is a one-off migration, and the doc plan reserves runbooks for recurring procedures.
cards: Doc debt from `tf-provider-registry`, not 013: `terraform/modules/managed-vm/versions.tf:9-11` still says the `homelab` provider binary is "baked into the modern-app-dev image, which is the version source of truth" and cites `slices/completed/embed-homelab-provider.md`. Verified false — neither `support/iac-image/Dockerfile` nor `/work/DockerImages/modern-app-dev/Dockerfile` bakes a provider or a filesystem mirror; both resolve `registry.terraform.io/pvginkel/*` from the `tfmirror.home` network mirror via `/etc/terraform.rc`. The twin claim in `docs/runbooks/operator-workstation.md` was fixed in this phase (runbooks are the doc phase's charter); this one is a code comment in a Terraform module, outside the diff's work list. One-line fix: point it at `slices/completed/tf-provider-registry.md`.
